audit.summary: No established substantive defect in the inspected smooth rigidity chain; positive firstmode extension, two-sided positiveWFcone, conjugacy ray sign, negative-mode elimination, normalized pairing, homology/Hodge step, Torelli marking separation, finitecover systole and conformal closing checks. Local preceding-display signs clarified. Separate C4 endpoint remains NeedsEvidence, not a defect verdict.
limitations: Counterevidence: C2,Lip gives bounded weak third derivatives, Hminus1 pullback and H2 composition; cone trace can split H2 remainder, so neither the regularity mismatch nor replacement of fullWF byfiniteWF alone refutes the conclusion.

Limitations: GR arxiv2210.02295v2 gives C^{r-1,Lip} at integer r; for C4 metrics/C3 flow the direct endpoint is C2,Lip, not the literal C3 in Remark3.9. Hminus1 and H2 pullback are bounded, but endpoint WF2 covariance/propagation for general Hminus1 input and complete low-regularity Pestov argument are not completed here. No C4 counterexample or smooth-main defect established.
